title: China August consumption slowdown and uneven domestic demand
discussion_signal: The post interprets weak August retail growth, property weakness, and stronger AI-linked manufacturing as a divergence between fragile domestic consumption and selected high-technology sectors. It complements the atlas category and price divergence signal while preserving the distinction between aggregate sales and household welfare.
linked_research_question: How can weak aggregate consumption coexist with category, price, property, and technology-sector divergence?
limits: Commentary summarizes official data rather than providing a household panel
LinkedIn audience and framing are selective
Retail growth does not measure welfare or distributional exposure
